text_block_list.text:
After school, while walking near the 
school gates—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Oh, look, it's Biko-chan! 'Sup, 'sup~☆

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Mayano! You heading back from training 
too?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya got tire—er, something like that♪ 
Wanna go hang out together, Biko-chan?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Then how about the shopping 
district? I know a super special place!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh! A toy store~!?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya's long graduated from childish stuff 
like toys, you know~!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Toys don't care if you're an adult or a 
kid! Come on, over here!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Look! Every hero lined up here has been 
loved by adults for years and years!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Mmmh... When Maya was little, I watched 
Magical☆Derby-ko instead of heroes, so I 
don't really get it!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I see. Even so, Derby-ko is a hero too!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Anyone with justice in their heart is a 
hero!" Carrotman said so while mountain 
climbing!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Mountain climbing!? What does that even 
mean!?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Good eye, Mayano! Carrotman doesn't just 
beat up the bad guys!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
He puts his whole body on the line to take 
on any challenge, giving courage to 
everyone watching!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hang gliding, cheerleading, skiing... Even 
if he fails, he gets right back up and 
tries again and again—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Guh, it's so passionate!! Carrotman really 
is the coolest, right?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...U-Um, Maya feels like she just heard a 
lifetime's worth of Carrotman talk~

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You really love Carrotman, don't you, 
Biko-chan?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! A sense of justice that never 
overlooks the smallest evil! A strong 
heart that confronts any hardship!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Fighting to protect everyone's dreams and 
hopes... Carrotman is who I look up to!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm gonna keep winning races 
and become a hero who gives courage to the 
crowd!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I see~. Maya would rather be way cuter and 
sexier, but—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
That's what you wanna be, right, 
Biko-chan!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Just you watch, Mayano, I'm gonna 
become an incredible hero one day!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya's gonna become an amazing adult too! 
"Magical☆ Miracle☆Make Debut☆"... Just 
kidding♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
If you're Derby Girl, then I'm... "Full 
Nutrition! Full Justice! Carotene 
Charge!!" Hyah!!
